title: Artisan Bread Baking Class in Phoenix (Star & Braided Loaves)
includes: Phoenix studio venue with an intimate 4-guest limit (up to 16 for private/at-home sessions)
Step-by-step artisan bread instruction with kneading, shaping, and baking guidance
Full menu with enriched yeasted dough, pesto star bread, and braided seeded loaf
This is a BYOB event. Guests are welcome to bring wine and beer to enjoy during the class (not included)
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
policies: This cooking class is designed to accommodate a variety of dietary needs! Please let us know in advance, and we'll do our best to tailor the experience to suit your preferences and restrictions.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Dive into the art of artisan bread baking in Phoenix, hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to 4 guests in-studio, this intimate workshop guides you step by step in preparing enriched yeasted doughs.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Enriched yeasted dough for versatile breads
- Pull-apart pesto star bread filled with sunflower seed pesto and Pecorino Romano
- Black and white seed braided bread topped with sesame and poppy seeds
- Sunflower seed pesto for dipping or spreading

You’ll learn kneading, shaping, and filling techniques while gaining confidence to recreate these breads at home. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy as they bake and share their creations in this 2-hour class.
